_comment: Minimal fixture for the SAME70Q20B boot/connect smoke test. No analog_in / i2c / step_trigger entries - the test just verifies that the firmware boots through SystemInit, generic/armcm_timer advances against the local DWT model (frequency 300000000), and klippy completes its identify + clocksync handshake over the UART2 pty Renode exposes. AFEC0/AFEC1 stub regions are injected by the launcher but are not driven here - they exist to keep ADC reads from faulting if SystemInit happens to touch them.
